section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes the YBIS (YouBeauty Image Survey), an online cross-sectional survey conducted between September and December 2012 on the YouBeauty.com website. Participants were recruited from website visitors and completed a seven-page survey that included the Body Appreciation Scale, Subjective Happiness Scale, and Photographic Figure Rating Scale, with demographic information collected on the penultimate page. The study received ethics approval and participants provided informed consent online without compensation.
